Classic Margherita Pizza|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|2 servings|30 mins|optional ingredients|Spread pizza dough with tomato sauce, top with slices of mozzarella cheese and fresh basil leaves. Bake until crust is golden. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|8 servings|45 mins|as needed|Stuff chicken breasts with a mixture of spinach, feta, garlic, and herbs. Bake until chicken is cooked through. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Beef Stir Fry|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|2 servings|3 hrs|as desired|Stir-fry beef slices with broccoli, bell peppers, and onions in soy sauce and garlic. Serve over rice or noodles. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Garlic Butter Shrimp|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|3-4 servings|30 mins|various amounts|Sauté shrimp in butter and minced garlic until pink. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Vegetable Stir Fry with Tofu|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|3-4 servings|45 mins|adjustable|Stir-fry tofu cubes until golden, add assorted vegetables and a stir-fry sauce. Serve over rice or noodles. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.
Veggie and Hummus Sandwich|An ideal recipe for experimenting with different flavors and ingredients.|6 servings|30 mins|as desired|Spread hummus on bread, add cucumber, bell pepper, carrot, and lettuce. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Spicy Tuna Wraps|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|3-4 servings|20 mins|as per recipe|Mix canned tuna with mayo and sriracha. Spread on tortillas, add lettuce and cucumber slices, roll up. Garnish with fresh herbs for a more vibrant taste.
Raspberry Almond Smoothie|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|3-4 servings|3 hrs|as needed|Blend together raspberries, almond milk, banana, and a scoop of almond butter until smooth. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
Baked Cod with Lemon and Dill|A delicious and healthy choice for any time of the day.|1 serving|3 hrs|various amounts|Place cod fillets in a baking dish, season with lemon juice, dill, salt, and pepper. Bake until fish flakes easily. Feel free to substitute with ingredients you have on hand.
Tomato Basil Bruschetta|A quick and easy meal, perfect for busy weekdays.|3-4 servings|1 hrs|subject to change|Top sliced baguette with a mix of chopped tomatoes, basil, garlic, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Try adding a pinch of your favorite spices for extra flavor.
